run_retrieval_bm25: run BM25 retrieval on queries against a document corpus using gensim LuceneBM25Model
run_retrieval_sbert_bge: run dense retrieval using BGE or SBERT sentence transformer models with cosine similarity
run_retrieval_openai: run retrieval using OpenAI text-embedding-3-large embeddings with automatic text truncation
run_retrieval_sf_qwen_e5: run retrieval using Salesforce SFR, Qwen, or E5 Mistral 7B embedding models
calculate_retrieval_metrics: calculate NDCG, MAP, Recall, Precision, and MRR metrics using pytrec_eval
